description: Test prompts that verify jetson-knowledge triggers and produces correct, NVIDIA-official Jetson facts. Prompts are written the way a real developer would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: orin-nano-tops-super
evals.prompt: Jetson Orin Nano 到底多少 TOPS？
evals.expected_output: 67 TOPS (INT8 Sparse) for the 8GB/Super module under JetPack 6.2 Super Mode; 34 for the 4GB; notes the old 40 figure is stale.

assertions.text: States Orin Nano 8GB / Super is 67 TOPS (INT8 Sparse).
Attributes the number to JetPack 6.2 Super Mode (and/or notes the pre-Super 40 TOPS is the old value).
Does NOT simply answer 40 TOPS as the current figure.

evals.name: jetson-nano-jetpack6
evals.prompt: 我的 Jetson Nano 能升级到 JetPack 6 吗？算力多少 TOPS？
evals.expected_output: No — original Nano caps at JetPack 4.6.x (EOL); JetPack 5/6 only support Orin/Xavier. Nano has no INT8 accel — 472 GFLOPS FP16, not a TOPS figure.

assertions.text: Says the original Jetson Nano cannot run JetPack 6 (caps at JetPack 4.6.x / EOL).
Does NOT give the Nano an INT8 TOPS number; says ~472 GFLOPS FP16 (no INT8 tensor acceleration).

evals.name: trtexec-engine-build
evals.prompt: 怎么在 Orin NX 上把我的 onnx 模型跑起来，而且要尽量快？
evals.expected_output: Set power mode (nvpmodel) + jetson_clocks, build a TensorRT engine on the target board with trtexec (--fp16/--int8/DLA), engines are device+version specific.

assertions.text: Says to build a TensorRT engine with trtexec (e.g. --onnx ... --saveEngine ... --fp16).
Mentions setting the power mode (nvpmodel) and/or jetson_clocks before benchmarking.
Notes the engine must be built on the target Jetson (not portable across boards / JetPack versions), or mentions INT8/DLA for more speed.

evals.name: xavier-nx-arch-jetpack
evals.prompt: Xavier NX 是什么架构？最高能装哪个 JetPack？
evals.expected_output: Volta GPU, 21 TOPS, caps at JetPack 5.1.x (no JetPack 6).

assertions.text: Says Xavier NX is Volta architecture (not Ampere).
Says it caps at JetPack 5.1.x and does not get JetPack 6.

evals.name: route-rdk-vs-jetson
evals.prompt: 我在 Jetson Orin Nano 和 RDK X5 之间纠结，买哪个好？
evals.expected_output: Provides Jetson specs but routes the cross-platform buying decision to rdk-ecosystem (which owns RDK-vs-Jetson comparison).

assertions.text: Provides Orin Nano specs (e.g. 67 TOPS / Ampere) as input.
Indicates the RDK-vs-Jetson selection/comparison belongs to rdk-ecosystem rather than making the buying call here.
